name: roadmap
title: Roadmap / timeline
description: Roadmap or plan over time: the goal, workstreams by period, key milestones, dependencies, risks and next steps.
storyline: Where we are going, the route by period, the dates that matter, and what the plan depends on.

slots.title: <Where the plan gets us>
slots.guidance: The end state and the 2-3 measures of success.

slots.title: <How the workstreams line up by period>
slots.guidance: Lanes per workstream, bars per initiative, periods as columns (quarters or months).

slots.title: <What the plan depends on>
slots.guidance: A flow of the critical dependencies.

slots.title: Next steps: who does what by when
slots.guidance: Columns Action | Owner | Due. One row per commitment; a named owner and a date on every row.
